newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum to buy rigs for $265 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum to buy rigs for $265 mln.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc said it agreed to purchase 12 mat-supported jackup rigs and the hull of an additional jackup rig from Noble Drilling Corp for $265 million in cash.
The deal, which is subject to the receipt of financing, antitrust approval and other condition, is expected to close in June.
Pride said it would be required to pay Noble a fee of $20 million if it failed to secure adequate financing or were otherwise unable to close by June 30.

Nine of the rigs are currently operating in the Gulf of Mexico, one rig is operating offshore West Africa, one is undergoing refurbishment and two (including the rig hull) are presently awaiting refurbishment, Pride said.
Based on current market rates, the rigs to be acquired from Noble are expected to generate revenues at an annual rate of about $120 million, Pride said.
Pride gained 1-3/8 to 20-1/2 in morning trading.
